title: Pizza With 3n Slices
description: Select n non-adjacent slices from 3n slices to maximize sum, treating the pizza as circular.

steps.note: Splitting circular array [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6] into two linear cases to break cycle.
Calculating max sum for first helper case: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] picking 2 slices.
DP transition: comparing current best without slice vs including current slice.
First helper returned max sum for first linear slice subset.
Combining results from both linear subproblems to handle circular constraint.
